text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka delivered a magnificent 
performance in the Yayoi Sho as well.

However... seeing another Umamusume shed 
tears of frustration made her question 
whether her own reason for running was 
truly right.

Unable to focus on racing in this state, 
Silence Suzuka speaks up, wanting to 
withdraw from the Satsuki Sho.

However, realizing it wasn't good to lack 
a goal, she set her sights once again on 
the Kobe Shimbun Hai and aimed for a fresh 
start.
